nodes.asset_description: A pinkish-purple curved line on a white background. The line starts on the left side, curves upward and to the right, and ends on the right side.
A curved, magenta-colored line is drawn on a white background. The line starts near the top left and extends to the right, slightly curved.
A pink, cursive letter “g” is centered on a white background. The letter is formed by swirling lines and curves.
A pink, curvy line on a white background. The line starts at the top and curves downward and to the right, ending in a loop.

nodes.asset_description: A cartoon figure with dark skin and short dark hair sits cross-legged, wearing a coral pink hooded sweatshirt and teal socks with white stripes. The figure holds a light purple book open with both hands, facing forward. The background is plain white.
A person with dark hair, wearing a yellow long-sleeved shirt and light pink pants, is seated and reading a light teal book. They are wearing white sneakers. The background is entirely black.

A person with brown curly hair and glasses is lying down, wearing a teal polka-dotted shirt and purple pants. They are holding a book open with both hands, resting their feet on the pages. The person is wearing brown loafers with black straps. The background is plain white.

A stylized figure with green hair, a pink scarf, and a pink sweater holds an open yellow book. The figure is positioned in a relaxed pose with legs bent and feet pointing outward. The background is plain white.

A stack of five books with teal, blue, and yellow spines is shown against a white background. The books are arranged vertically, with the top book being green, the next two blue, the third yellow, the fourth teal, and the bottom book purple. The spines have white text and edges.

Two open books are shown against a white background. The book on the left is teal with a brown bookmark and horizontal lines on the cover. The book on the right is pink with horizontal lines on the cover. Both books are slightly angled toward each other.

Two open books are displayed on a transparent background. The left book is teal with gold bands and orange accents. The right book is pink with cream-colored pages. Both books are oriented with their pages facing upwards. The background consists of a repeating gray and white checkerboard pattern.

Two books are stacked on top of each other. The top book is yellow with a white cover and a rectangular label. The bottom book is teal with a white cover and a black spine. Both books are oriented horizontally.
An open book with cream-colored pages and dark lines is depicted against a transparent background of gray and white checkered squares. A red bookmark is positioned on the right page.

An open book with a red cover and cream-colored pages is shown against a transparent background. The pages are lined with horizontal lines, and the book is positioned with its spine facing upwards. The cover has a simple, slightly textured design.

A closed book with an orange cover and a yellow leaf symbol on the front is shown. The book is angled slightly to the right, revealing its white pages. The cover has a dark red spine and edges. The background is transparent.

An open book with a peach-colored cover and a yellow spine lies at an angle against a white background. The pages are white with visible texture, and the spine is slightly curved. The book is depicted in a cartoon or illustrative style.

A dark blue book with a white rectangular label featuring three small white snowflake icons is depicted against a transparent background. The book is closed and oriented diagonally, with its spine visible on the right side.
